evidence.why: argv is scanned but other args beginning with '-'/'--' are not filtered/rejected, matching the rubric's argv-handling vulnerability condition.

Parsed URL (host, path, query) is passed directly to an arbitrary external handler with no hardcoded route map, no host allowlist, and no typed parameter schema, so the link can dictate navigation/authority.
No scheme/host validation against an exact allowlist before dispatch; same pattern repeated for second-instance and open-url handlers.
